 PRAMOD JOSHI S/O SH. RAMESHWARI JOSHI, AGED  ABOUT 26 YEARS, OCCUPATION: LABOUR VILLAGE  GADHAI POLICE STATION KARERA, DISTRICT  SHIVPURI (M.P) (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ANIL MISHRA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION DINARA, DISTRICT SHIVPURI (M.P) (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI R.S.KUSHWAHA - DEPUTY ADVOCATE GENERAL)

sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.
The applicant has filed this fourth application u/S. 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 13.08.2023 in connection with Crime No.21/2022 registered at Police Station Dinara District Shivpuri for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 469, 470, 471 of IPC and Section 25/27 of Arms Act.
2. It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that applicant has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is further submitted that material prosecution witnesses have been examined therefore, chance of tampering with evidence/witnesses is remote.
It is further submitted that other accused have been enlarge on bail.
Only source of implication is memo under Section 27 of Evidence Act.
No recovery has been made from the applicant.
Applicant does not bear any criminal record.
Confinement amounts to pretrial detention.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial/investigation and would abide by all the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.

He further undertakes Pramod Joshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139621578/

sentences.text: not to move in the vicinity of complainant side and shall not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to them in any manner.
Under these grounds, he prayed for bail.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
6.

Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and status of trial as well as the fact that applicant does not bear any criminal record, but without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

(viii) Applicant shall not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant party in any manner and shall not move in the vicinity of the complainant otherwise, benefit of bail shall immediately withdrawn.
8. Application stands allowed and disposed of.
9. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
